core_obligations: Build the free module: the proof sheafifies the presheaf of free modules on the sets of sections of a given sheaf of sets, records the canonical map from that free module onto any module of the same kind, and sets up the shorthand for the sections of the free module (proof lines 4984-4997)

Impose the relations: the displayed map of modules from a direct sum of three free modules onto the free module on the structure sheaf encodes additivity, the Leibniz rule and the compatibility with the map of sheaves of rings, and the universal module of differentials is defined as its cokernel (proof lines 4998-5013)
Produce the universal derivation: the proof shows that assigning to a local section the image of the corresponding free generator yields a derivation of the required kind (proof lines 5014-5020)

Prove the universal property: any derivation into a module gives a map on the free module that annihilates the relations, hence factors through the cokernel, and the composite with the universal derivation is the given derivation (proof lines 5020-5031)
proof_roadmap: 先定义自由模 O_2[F]（把 U ↦ O_2(U)[F(U)] 层化）与标准映射 c；再用一个三项直和到 O_2[O_2] 的映射同时编码加性、Leibniz 法则与 φ 的相容性，其余核记为 Ω_{O_2/O_1}。
由 f ↦ [f] 的像得到 O_1-导子 d；对任意导子 D，O_2[O_2] → F（[g] ↦ D(g)）零化上述关系，故过余核得到 α_D 且 D = α_D ∘ d，即表示性。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the representability of the functor sending a sheaf of modules to the group of derivations from a sheaf of rings into it (author lemma at source lines 4971-4980, label lemma-universal-module). The proof (source lines 4982-5032) is a complete construction: it sheafifies the free module on the sets of sections, writes the three families of relations defining a derivation in one displayed map, defines the universal module of differentials as its cokernel, obtains the universal derivation from the free generators, and shows by the same calculation that every derivation factors uniquely through it (proof lines 4998-5031). The construction of the cokernel together with the verification of the universal property is the content. H2.
